articles.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
articles.description: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

articles.title: Trump says MAGA Inc. PAC will pay for controversial TV ads that government funded
articles.description: The New York Times reported "Trump personally instructed his budget director to use taxpayer money for TV ads praising him and his presidency."

articles.title: Trump offers U.S. help to Russia after plague death; WHO assesses the situation as low risk
articles.description: WHO said it was in contact with Russian authorities, and has offered support if needed, while assessing the risk to the general public as low based on available information.

articles.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
articles.description: ZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.

articles.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Starbucks enters Xinjiang in calculated geopolitical risk
articles.description: Starbucks struck one of Asia's most closely watched deals last year. Now it is getting headaches over choices made by a partner that leans toward Beijing.

articles.title: AI researcher warns 'we are racing to build and grow our own adversary' in NYC hearing
articles.description: The leading AI labs facing intensifying scrutiny over their safety and security practices.

articles.title: Russian gold floods Hong Kong as Western sanctions redraw bullion trade
articles.description: The surge underscores how Russia's gold trade has been rerouted after its invasion of Ukraine in 2022 shut its producers out of major Western markets.

articles.title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.

articles.title: Stocks are hitting records despite surging yields. Cramer explains why
articles.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said Nvidia, Microsoft and Meta are helping push stocks to records even as surging Treasury yields pressure much of the broader market.

articles.title: Nokia CEO says data centers would be built '2x faster' without supply constraints
articles.description: The Nokia CEO's comments underscores continued demand for AI even as top executives debate slowing down the pace of development.

articles.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
articles.description: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

articles.title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
articles.description: Fairshake said it would financially back 32 House candidates who all voted in favor of the CLARITY market structure bill in 2025, as the legislation remains in limbo in the Senate.

articles.title: House Democrat targets candidate prediction market trades after opponent’s Kalshi penalty
articles.description: A new bill bans federal candidates from trading prediction market contracts related to their own elections and would result in a fine if violated.

articles.title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
articles.description: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.

articles.title: Lucid's Q3 deliveries fall 6.7% as EV maker cuts production to align with demand
articles.description: Lucid delivered 3,806 EVs and produced 2,954 vehicles during the third quarter. That compared with 4,078 deliveries on production of 3,891 vehicles a year earlier.

articles.title: 'We had a threat': Trump explains U.S. moving long-range bombers from UK
articles.description: The U.S. Air Force B-1 bombers removed from England have been used in strikes on Iran.

articles.title: FinCEN withdraws proposed crypto mixing rule over ‘legitimate activity’ concerns
articles.description: The bureau under the US Treasury said it was withdrawing two proposed rules on unhosted wallets and crypto mixers ”as part of the Trump Administration’s deregulatory agenda.”

articles.title: Why a 4chan Bitcoin Prophecy Says Today Is the End of Crypto Winter
articles.description: An anonymous 4chan user called Bitcoin's October 2025 peak to the day way back in 2023. Could they be right again?

articles.title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
articles.description: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a runoff on Oct. 25.

articles.title: Treasury Kills Crypto 'Unhosted Wallet' and Mixer Surveillance Rules
articles.description: FinCEN withdrew a 2020 proposal to track transactions with self-custodial crypto wallets and a 2023 plan to designate crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern.
